question: Should this PR be reworked to use tracked package or approved vendoring provenance and narrower math delimiters, or may OpenClaw accept a self-hosted MathJax bundle with global single-dollar parsing?
rationale: The remaining blockers are not only mechanical: maintainers need to accept the browser supply-chain boundary and the user-visible delimiter behavior before a repair lane can safely choose the implementation shape.

options.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
options.body: Require package/build or approved vendoring provenance and remove `$...$` inline parsing unless explicitly accepted later.

options.title: Accept owner-approved vendoring
options.body: Allow the bundled MathJax asset only with documented source, version, license, update process, and security review.

options.title: Defer this branch
options.body: Keep the canonical feature request open and revisit with a markdown-stage or default-off implementation.

recommendation.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
recommendation.body: Require package/build or approved vendoring provenance and remove `$...$` inline parsing unless explicitly accepted later.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent adjacent Control UI CSP, dependency, package, and gateway security history relevant to accepting same-origin browser code.
